name: Lafayette 1889
designer: Unidentified in the consulted historical specimen
description: Tall condensed display letters with fine crossbars, triangular serifs and a distinct historical lowercase.
observed: Directly traced characters: 0123456789ABCDEFGHILMNOPQRSTUWXYacdeghiklmnoprstuvy. Printed page 185, PDF page 191. Larger impressions anchor the master; smaller sizes supply additional characters. Original crops are also retained for separately labelled reconstructions.
reconstructed: Inferred companion letters and figures: JKZbjqwz. Punctuation and remaining symbols are new project drawings. Both historical cases are retained. Spacing and harmonisation of optical sizes are modern choices. The 1889 suffix dates the source, not a claim of first release. Characters redrawn in place of coarse small-size traces: Vfx; see companions.json for the construction of each.

sources.title: Specimen book from the Boston type foundry (1889), Lafayette; printed p. 185, one-based PDF page 191, Internet Archive leaf 191
sources.rights: 1889 US publication, public domain under the maximum historical 95-year term. Library of Congress scan hosted by Internet Archive; retained institutional metadata says the Library is unaware of copyright restrictions. Original native JP2 leaf; no modern digital typeface used.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: Reviewed transcriptions and exact native crops are retained in source/rows.json, selections.json and tracing.json. New companions are recorded separately with construction notes. Measured baselines include page slope. Optical-size differences and ornamental spurs are retained; small-source replacements are explicitly labelled.
